tasks.title: Observational Competition (Night) - O5
tasks.statement: You will use a telescope to observe five red LED screens at a distance. The telescope is equipped with one eyepiece, but no finderscope. Some of these screens display the names of planets, some show Messier numbers, and some show equatorial coordinates.

parts.question: The eyepiece’s field of view is 45°. Please estimate the field of view (with an accuracy of 0.1°) of quadrados the telescope when observing.

tasks.title: Observational Competition (Night) - O6
tasks.statement: You will use a telescope to observe five red LED screens at a distance. The telescope is equipped with one eyepiece, but no finderscope. Some of these screens display the names of planets, some show Messier numbers, and some show equatorial coordinates.

parts.question: Write down the text you observed on the screen.
